title: The Primary school of the village
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：primary　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 primary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the craftsman wrote of ① a primary school of the village in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so primary that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the primary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the primary school of the village that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1942 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too primary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the primary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a primary reason for the change, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as primary as the reason for the change they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was primary or not, and he said so.

By 1955 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something primary, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite primary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the primary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1958, for the whole place, she wrote of another primary school of the village in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less primary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The primary reason for the change that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1960, was the one she could never quite name; the primary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 初级（前置定语 a primary school of the village：1948 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件初级的小学）
B. adj. 初级／首要（两处加强说法：so primary that … 与 no less primary than …）
C. adj. 初级／首要（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 初级（表语 too primary to do：母亲觉得它太初级，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 首要（前置定语 a primary reason for the change：叔叔把整件事称作一桩首要的原因）
F. adj. 首要（同级比较 as primary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩变革的首要原因相比）
G. adj. 首要（后置定语 something primary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 首要（受程度副词修饰 quite primary：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a primary school of the village
the primary school of the village that
a primary reason for the change
The primary reason for the change that

answers.why: primary 意为“初级”，1948 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件初级的小学”，此处作前置定语 a primary school of the village。
primary 意为“初级”，此处用 so primary that 结构，说它初级到工坊里没人敢靠近。
primary 意为“初级”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的初级村里的小学，等于最高级的说法。
primary 意为“初级”，母亲认为这件东西“太初级了，谁也用不上”，too primary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
primary 意为“首要”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩首要的原因”，此处作前置定语 a primary reason for the change。
primary 意为“首要”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩变革的首要原因一样首要”，同级比较用 as primary as。
primary 意为“首要”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“首要的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something primary。
primary 意为“首要”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当首要”，quite 修饰原级 primary。
primary 意为“首要”，no less primary than 表示“其首要不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之首要不亚于任何人的预料。
primary 意为“首要”，母亲 1960 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的首要原因”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1948 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件初级的小学。（a primary school of the village）
它初级到工坊里没有一个人敢靠近。（so primary that …）
母亲觉得它太初级，谁也用不上。（too primary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩首要的原因。（a primary reason for the change）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩变革的首要原因一样首要。（as primary as …）
到了 1955 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件首要的东西。（something primary）
answers: In 1948 the craftsman wrote of a primary school of the village in the ledger.
It was so primary that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too primary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a primary reason for the change.
He said nobody would call it as primary as the reason for the change they had once had.
By 1955 the ledger asked for nothing but something primary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 primary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the craftsman wrote of a primary school of the village in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the primary school of the village that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too primary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a primary reason for the change, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite primary, and everybody laughed.
The primary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
